    Bottle Description

    Launched in 2023, Macallan's Colour Collection comprises five age-statement malts which range from 12 to 30 years old. The collection is a tribute to the distilleries dedication to producing natural-coloured whiskies. Each release has been aged in sherry seasoned oak casks from Jerez de la Frontera, Spain.

    Exclusive to the travel retail market, the whisky has been matured for a minimum of 30 years in American and European sherry-seasoned casks.

    Important Notice

    All items are carefully inspected and any marks or damage are noted within the lot description. We do however strongly recommend that you undertake a thorough close-up inspection prior to placing any bids. If you are not satisfied with the information shown and would like more details, please contact us on info@prestigewhiskyauction.com and our team will be happy to help. It is also important to note that lots will be sold as seen and described.

    It is important to note that should an outer box be provided, it will be photographed and shown regardless of the condition. If there is not an image of an outer box, this means it is absent and will not be provided.

    All lots can have insurance against breakage or loss during transit added at an additional cost. This is available to add at the checkout at a cost of 4% of the hammer price. Due to the various ages of bottles and their seals, condition of the liquid is at the buyer's discretion and no claim can be lodged against leakage in transit.

    Frequent Questions
    How much does it cost to buy a lot during auction?

    The successful bidder will be charged the following fees:


    Buyer Commission – 10% of final winning bid, known as hammer price.
    Delivery – Costs for delivery will depend on shipping address and size/weight of
    package. See Shipping & Insurance for more information.


    Please note that VAT (currently 20%) will be added to all costs for UK-based buyers. Those out with the UK will not be charged VAT however it may be applicable for the country to which the package is being shipped.

    When is payment due for bottles I have won?

    Payment should be made immediately after an auction has ended. We will allow up to 72 hours from auction end to make payment in full. If you haven’t paid for your won items within 72 hours, you will be charged a late payment fee which is 4% of the full outstanding balance.

    How quickly will I receive my winning lot?

    At the checkout, you will see the delivery charge and the estimated transit time. Every order will be shipped via a trackable courier service and a tracking number will be provided to you. To avoid any disappointment, please make sure that we can ship to your country prior to bidding in an auction. Full information on shipping, including destinations, can be found on our shipping & insurance page.
